events.title: Combat, Controls & Quality-of-Life Update
events.summary: Combat & AbilitiesUpdated Split Shot’s Yaw Arc mode to increase particle emission and spread from a single effect. Other spread modes retain their existing behavior.Updated attack animations to support multiple firing events within one animation.Removed Retaliate to keep the ability controls focused around Repulse.Updated ControlsController dash is now mapped to left-stick click (L3). Keyboard dash remains C.Removed mouse-wheel camera zoom. Mouse-wheel scrolling remains available in menus.UI & S

events.title: UberLoop 6.108.4
events.summary: Iron Beast is in the fight. Big, bossy, and built to pressure you with a real attack kit — punches, ground waves, artillery, the works.Fights feel alive again. Enemies mix their moves instead of spamming one forever, keep coming after a cooldown, and actually idle while they wait instead of locking up mid-pose.Ground attacks now tear toward you along the floor. When something big swings, you’ll feel the knockback without the old sticky slide.Magic Missile Overload keeps scaling when you stack it

events.title: Push is live — play UberLoop on a controller
events.summary: This update is about two things: a new ability, and playing from the couch.Push Deal damage and your Push bar fills. When it's full, hit B (or Q) and blast everything around you.Each character has their own Push strength, and it gets stronger as you level. The upgrades you pick in a run apply to it the same way they apply to your attack.When it's ready, the bar says REPULSE READY and the screen pulses purple so you don't miss it.Controller You can run UberLoop with a controller now — menus, char

events.title: UberLoop 6.101.6
events.summary: TurretsAs you explore, a small set of turrets plant on the ground around you. They do not chase.They arrive with the same lightning strike as other enemies.When you step into range they turn to face you, then fire.Two kinds: rocket turrets (artillery, longer range) and bullet turrets (faster, closer shots).You bump into them. You cannot walk through the gun.Walk far enough away and those turrets go away. New ones plant in the neighborhood you are in now.Killing one still counts as a normal enemy

events.title: UberLoop 6.99.5
events.summary: CoverBuildings, cliffs, and trees between the camera and you cut open so the survivor stays on screen. The hole scales in when you are blocked and closes when you are not.Ground under you stays. Walking on top of a cliff or roof does not punch a hole through it.When the hole opens, a prompt on the HUD reminds you that you can rotate the camera.CombatHold up+left or up+right to shoot on those diagonals. Aim stays there after you let go until you pick a new direction.The shot-ready meter is a bar
